Train SWAE-Clustering (Fast Version)

Source: R/MMD_Vae.R
trainSWAEClusteringFast.Rd

A faster alternative to trainSWAEClustering that eliminates per-batch R-to-TF tensor conversions. Uses the same R-level training loop and shuffling as the original but pre-converts all data to TF tensors once and uses TF gather for batching. Supports the core SWAE + DSW + supervised clustering pipeline.

Usage

trainSWAEClusteringFast(
  trainData,
  useMarkers,
  nClusters = 10L,
  pseudoLabels = NULL,
  epochs = 100L,
  latentDim = 16L,
  lambda = 0.1,
  lambdaCluster = 1,
  numProjections = 50L,
  batchSize = 32L,
  learningRate = 0.001,
  hiddenSizes = c(23L, 19L),
  clusterWarmup = 10L,
  jointFineTune = FALSE,
  jointEpochs = 30L,
  labelSmoothing = 0,
  dropout = 0,
  useBatchNorm = FALSE,
  useLayerNorm = FALSE,
  weightDecay = 0,
  useDSW = FALSE,
  dswMaxIter = 10L,
  dswLambda = 1,
  verbose = 1L,
  seed = 1994
)

Arguments

trainData

A data frame or matrix containing the training data.

useMarkers

Character vector of column names to use as input features.

nClusters

Integer, number of clusters (default 10).

pseudoLabels

Optional vector of pseudo-labels for supervised training.

epochs

Integer, total number of training epochs (default 100).

latentDim

Integer, dimensionality of the latent space (default 16).

lambda

Numeric, weight for Sliced Wasserstein distance loss (default 0.1).

lambdaCluster

Numeric, weight for clustering loss (default 1.0).

numProjections

Integer, number of random projections for SW (default 50).

batchSize

Integer, training batch size (default 32).

learningRate

Numeric, learning rate for optimizer (default 1e-3).

hiddenSizes

Integer vector of length 2, hidden layer sizes (default c(23, 19)).

clusterWarmup

Integer, epochs for Stage 1 SWAE warmup (default 10).

jointFineTune

Logical, whether to do Stage 3 joint fine-tuning (default FALSE).

jointEpochs

Integer, number of Stage 3 epochs (default 30).

labelSmoothing

Numeric, label smoothing factor (default 0.0).

dropout

Numeric, dropout rate (default 0.0).

useBatchNorm

Logical, use batch normalization (default FALSE).

useLayerNorm

Logical, use layer normalization (default FALSE).

weightDecay

Numeric, weight decay for AdamW (default 0.0).

useDSW

Logical, use Distributional Sliced Wasserstein (default FALSE).

dswMaxIter

Integer, DSW inner optimization steps (default 10).

dswLambda

Numeric, DSW diversity regularization strength (default 1.0).

verbose

Integer, verbosity level (default 1).

seed

Integer, random seed (default 1994).

Value

A list containing trained encoder, decoder, clusterHead models, and training history.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
model <- trainSWAEClusteringFast(trainData, useMarkers, nClusters = 11,
  pseudoLabels = labels, epochs = 100, latentDim = 16,
  hiddenSizes = c(23, 19), clusterWarmup = 20,
  useDSW = TRUE, dswMaxIter = 10, dswLambda = 1.0)
} # }
